claimChecks.claim: Crossing vessel at adult UPJ necessarily causes obstruction and every accessory renal artery ligation inevitably infarcts a segment
claimChecks.locator: O'Sullivan indexed results; Triantafyllou pooled prevalence; Karmacharya selected EVAR abstract
claimChecks.note: Association/presence is not individual causation; arterial consequences depend on supplied territory and setting. EVAR evidence is indirect to renal surgery.

claimChecks.claim: Donor compensatory hyperfiltration inevitably causes proteinuria or glomerulosclerosis
claimChecks.locator: Lenihan original results/discussion excerpts; KDIGO Ch. 19
claimChecks.note: A 21-donor physiologic cohort showed adaptation without albuminuria at median 6.3 years, not a lifetime guarantee; retain donor surveillance.

claimChecks.claim: Every post-contrast AKI is contrast-induced; medulla or proximal tubule is invariably first affected
claimChecks.locator: ACR/NKF consensus terminology and risk section, indexed excerpts
claimChecks.note: Distinguished association from proven causation and removed universal anatomic sequence; full mechanism package remains open.

claimChecks.claim: A universal 25-minute warm-ischemia boundary mandates zero/off-clamp partial nephrectomy
claimChecks.locator: Rod original abstract; EAU §7.2.3.b.9 and recommendation table
claimChecks.note: Preserved-parenchyma effect and selected CLOCK population limit the inference; no routine off-clamp superiority in normal baseline function.

claimChecks.claim: Abrupt postoperative hemoglobin decrease is expected from new renal EPO loss
claimChecks.note: CKD anemia is chronic and multifactorial; prompt evaluation of postoperative bleeding/dilution remains important.

claimChecks.claim: Living donor follow-up assesses BP, eGFR and albuminuria
claimChecks.note: Annual recommendation; no claim of all-donor lifetime outcome guarantee.
